document.abstract: In 1963 an experimental color television camera employing a new pickup tube, called the Plumbicon, was shown publicly by N. V. Philips Gloeilampenfabrieken of Holland. The camera and its integration into the existing CBS plant have been evaluated as well as the operating experience to date. Although a specific camera ir dealt with, the results obtained may be considered representative of the performance of Plumbicon color cameras manufactured by other companies.
